method: TKGM coordinate query GET /megsiswebapi.v3.1/api/parsel/{lat}/{lon}/ at 3 points (t=0.25,0.5,0.75) along each edge, 3 m outside the boundary
caveat: TKGM coordinates have 5 decimals (~1 m): a point 3 m outside an edge can hit a neighbour or the road with about +-1 m uncertainty.
